items.title: Hinton Milt — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: We got Earl Hines from Pittsburgh and they got Percy Venable from Pittsburgh also, a great choreographer and they put on a tremendous show.

ctx.x: Huge nightclub for that period. We got Earl Hines from Pittsburgh and they got Percy Venable from Pittsburgh also, a great choreographer and they put on a tremendous show. And then the gangsters started. They wanted something for themselves on the west side at Cicero‟s. Al Capone opened up a Cotton Club, which is black entertainment. No black customers of course.
In talking about Chicago in those early days when you first moved to Chicago, when did you start to play the violin? Was that when you began to study or did you study before?
